svg.title: GUITION CAN breakout: labelled top and underside
svg.desc: Isometric layout illustration using source placements and footprints, with simplified component bodies. Not a native 3D export or clearance model.

g.text: Placements, footprints, pads and track segments are read from the supplied PCB source.
Package bodies/heights are simplified; connector heights are illustrative. Copper pours are omitted.
Use the native project for fabrication, pin orientation and mechanical clearance checks.
